Name: Rabbit's Foot Lucky Oil
Author: Crafterbuddy
Description:
Adds Lucky Oil, an artisan good made from rabbit feet.
Processed using an oil maker.

Additionally grants +3 luck for about 8 minutes when consumed.

The fact that rabbit feet and duck feathers couldn't be processed into artisan goods annoyed me, and they were clogging up my Automate factories.
I made this mod (and the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14037]Duck Fabric[/url] mod) to fix it.
